name: Small World of Warcraft

rounds.endCondition: Game Turn marker reaches the last spot (10 rounds for 2-3 players, 9 for 4, 8 for 5); every player then plays a final turn

categories.label: Total Victory Coins at game end
categories.hint: Coins are scored at the end of each turn (1 per occupied Region plus race/power/Legendary Place/Artifact/faction bonuses); count your whole stack at the end.

categories.label: Race tokens still on the boards (Active + In Decline)
categories.labelVi: Số token chủng tộc còn trên bản đồ (Active + Decline)
categories.hint: Only used to break ties; does not add points.

tiebreakers.description: Most Race tokens (Active + In Decline) still on the boards

notes: family: running-track. Coins are collected during play (no end-game categories): each turn 1 coin per Region occupied by Active and In Decline races plus bonuses, and 1 coin per defeated opposing-faction race (Alliance vs Horde faction bonus). Coin totals stay hidden until the final reveal. Map/boards, race banners and special powers vary per game; those bonuses are not itemised here. Revenge of the Murlocs mini-expansion not modelled.
